title: Stocking stuffers under $30
say: Small things, chosen with care. Twelve pieces that fit in a stocking and would not look out of place under the tree.
description: Twelve stocking stuffers under $30, chosen by hand: a peptide lip balm, a stoneware sipper, ruffle socks, a beaded phone charm. The shop's own photos and prices.

items.name: Tell All coffee lip balm
items.alt: Bubble Tell All lip balm in its coffee brown tube.
items.note: Coffee and cream flavor, with a keychain to clip it on.

items.name: Velvet Peach Power Mist hand sanitizer
items.alt: Touchland Power Mist, a flat peach coloured bottle of hydrating hand sanitizer, 1 fl oz.
items.note: A fine mist that leaves hands soft. One fluid ounce, pocket sized.

items.name: Double ruffle socks
items.alt: A pair of socks with a double ruffle at the cuff, by Anthropologie.

items.name: Beaded phone charm
items.alt: A Sonix phone charm of amber, olive and blue glass beads, hanging from a pink phone case.
items.note: Glass beads on a wristlet. It hooks onto any phone case.

items.name: Glide 'n' Go body oil stick
items.alt: Frank Body Glide 'n' Go, a solid body oil in a twist up stick.
items.note: A solid body oil for elbows and knees, no mess. It smells of vanilla and coconut.

items.name: Stoneware demi sipper
items.alt: A small stoneware sipper cup by Pipe Dream Pottery, glazed in a soft colour.
items.note: Stoneware, made by Pipe Dream Pottery for Anthropologie. A small cup for the first coffee.

items.name: Le Chouchou peptide lip balm
items.alt: EADEM Le Chouchou lip balm in its tube.
items.note: A jelly balm that softens and smooths, with a peptide and hibiscus enzymes.

items.name: Lip butter balm
items.alt: Summer Fridays Lip Butter Balm in its cream coloured tube.
items.note: Shea and murumuru butters, a soft shine. Several flavors.

items.name: The Ribbon Stripe glass tumbler with lid
items.alt: A striped glass tumbler with a lid and a straw, by Anthropologie.

items.name: Slim can cooler
items.alt: A HydroJug slim can cooler in red gingham with a red screw-top lid.
items.note: Insulated steel with a screw-top lid, made for slim cans. This one in red gingham.

items.name: Pocket blush
items.alt: rhode pocket blush, a cream blush stick in a tan case with a raspberry pink bullet.
items.note: A cream blush in a stick, for cheeks and lips.

items.name: Emily Lex Studio watercolor workbook
items.alt: The Emily Lex Studio watercolor workbook, a Christmas edition, lying open.
